kultivator.meditation.start: You sit cross-legged and let your qi flow into the dantian. Moving, getting hurt, attacking or using anything ends the meditation.
kultivator.meditation.stop: You open your eyes and end your meditation.
kultivator.meditation.stop.moved: You moved and the flow of qi broke. Meditation ended.
kultivator.meditation.stop.hurt: Pain shatters your focus. Meditation ended.
kultivator.meditation.stop.attack: You cannot fight and meditate at once. Meditation ended.
kultivator.meditation.stop.use: Your hands left the mudra. Meditation ended.
kultivator.meditation.stop.dimension: Crossing between worlds scatters your qi. Meditation ended.
kultivator.meditation.stop.state: You can no longer sit still. Meditation ended.
kultivator.meditation.cannot.breakthroug: A breakthrough is already under way.
kultivator.meditation.cannot.riding: Dismount first: you need firm ground to sit on.
kultivator.meditation.cannot.flying: Land first: you cannot meditate while flying.
kultivator.meditation.cannot.water: Get out of the water first: you cannot meditate while swimming.
kultivator.meditation.cannot.ground: Stand on solid ground to sit down and meditate.
kultivator.meditation.bar.bottleneck: Bottleneck! Press %1$s to break through (or use the button in the %2$s scroll)
kultivator.meditation.vein_thin: The spirit vein here has grown thin (qi density %s%%). Meditate somewhere else; it recovers slowly on its own.
kultivator.meditation.formation_awake: The %s awakens: qi flows from its pillars into you.
kultivator.meditation.formation_lost: The formation around you falls silent.
kultivator.meditation.enlightenment.subt: For a moment the Dao is clear
kultivator.meditation.enlightenment.chat: A moment of enlightenment! Insight floods your meridians: +%s cultivation.
kultivator.meditation.debug.vein: Qi density of this region set to %s%%.
Sit cross-legged and meditate for the first time.
advancement.kultivator.spiritual_site.de: Meditate at a spiritual site: a mountain peak, a cherry grove, near a beacon, among amethyst, in the End or under the full moon.
advancement.kultivator.enlightenment.des: Gain a sudden insight into the Dao while meditating.
advancement.kultivator.qi_formation_smal: Meditate in a Small Qi Gathering Formation: 4 Blocks of Amethyst level with the block you sit on, 3 blocks away in each direction.
advancement.kultivator.qi_formation_grea: Meditate in a Great Qi Gathering Formation: sit on a Block of Gold with 8 Blocks of Amethyst level with your Block of Gold, 3 blocks away (sides and corners).
advancement.kultivator.qi_formation_heav: Complete the Heavenly Star Formation: End Rods on the four cardinal pillars and a Beacon or Lodestone under your Block of Gold.
advancement.kultivator.depleted_vein.des: Meditate in one place until its spirit vein runs thin.
